quests.title: Strange Stone Chronicle

dialogue.t: Puca, why are you here again?
There shouldn't be any more monsters nearby, but who knows what other dangers there might be...
Anyway, you shouldn't go running off on your own!
I didn't run off, Paimon and {NICKNAME}... I'm just looking for my token...
Huh? You lost your token?
Yup... It should be somewhere around that place I usually pick rocks from...
Hmm... You might've dropped it when you got trapped there before.
*sniff* Yeah, you might be right... I was too scared to care about anything else at that time...
It's still a little scary to think about, but my token's very important... I have to find it, I just have to...
Hmm... Paimon thinks it'll be too dangerous if Puca goes there on her own. In that case...
{NICKNAME}, why don't we take a trip back there and help Puca find her token? Puca, just go home and wait for us!

dialogue.sit: I've been wanting to explore that place anyway.

dialogue.t: Thank you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! I'll be good and wait for you at home.
My token is really important... I have to find it...
Puca, we're back! We found your token.

dialogue.sit: You give the token to Puca.

dialogue.t: Ohh, yes, this is the one! Thank you so much!
We also found something else while we were looking for your token...
It's an ore we've never seen before. We thought it might be valuable, so we brought it back!
If Paimon remembers correctly, you often pick up pretty stones around this area, right? Have you seen any stones like this before?
Let me see... It really is pretty! But it's not precious at all... it's just an ordinary stone...
It's true that you won't find anything like this in other places, but they're everywhere in nearby ore veins!
Aw, so it's just an ordinary rock! Paimon thought it looked super valuable...
Seems like we can't use it for anything else. Let's just find a place to dump it...

dialogue.sit: But if you can't find the ore elsewhere...
But if it's unique to this region...

dialogue.t: Oh, you mean we could make a fortune if we took it elsewhere and sold it?
You do have a point! People don't normally go mining in a Melusine village, which means they've probably never seen anything like this... Great thinking, {NICKNAME}!
C'mon, let's take this stone to the Court of Fontaine and show the merchants!
If there's anything else you'd like to know about ores, come find me anytime...
Though I don't run a gemstone workshop like my sister and don't know much about appraisals or processing...
Compared to precious gems, I prefer collecting all kinds of unique rocks...
I guess you can say I know the local ore veins pretty well!
Hehe, gotcha!
Welcome, welcome. Our store offers the most extensive selection of precious gems in the entire Court of Fontaine. We also have a wide range of craft goods on sale.
Anything catch your eye? If not, I would be delighted to meet any other demands!

dialogue.sit: We've got some mysterious ore here...

dialogue.t: Yup! Since you have such an extensive inventory, you should know its value, right?
Oh? So you're here to trade ore?
Then you've come to the right person! We offer some of the best and fairest prices in Fontaine.
Let's see what you have here...

dialogue.sit: You show Chesil the strange ore you found earlier.

dialogue.t: Whoa... Even I've never seen anything like this before...
The unique sheen and smooth texture... Ooh, this is no doubt a rare variety!
Pardon me for asking, but what exactly is this?
Is that why you're here for an appraisal?
It's such a shame you only brought one chunk of ore...
If only we had a steady supply... We could forge accessories that would take Fontaine by storm.
(Puca mentioned these stones were everywhere near the ore veins. Maybe we should ask her...)

dialogue.sit: We actually have a lot more of this ore.
The source is a trade secret.
You can find them around Elynas.

dialogue.t: Really? That's wonderful!
Anyway, in addition to the ore you brought, I'm willing to purchase more ore from you to make a batch of new products.
I'm willing to put down an advance payment to show my sincerity — as long as you bring more ore the next time you visit.
What do you think? I'd say it's a pretty fair deal.
Hehe, Paimon thinks so too! It's a deal!
Perfect! Here's your payment...
I wonder how the accessories made from this ore will turn out... Haha, can't say I'm not looking forward to it!
I'll be here, waiting for your good news.
Hey there, it's you again!
Is there anything you'd like to know about ore? You can ask me anything!
Even though I might not have an answer...

dialogue.sit: I don't have any more questions.

dialogue.t: There's lots of beautiful and sparkly stones in the ore veins nearby, but they're nowhere as good as real gemstones...
If I were better at finding real gemstones, maybe I could open my own gemstone workshop, just like Sluasi!

quests.description: In order to find Puca’s token, you once again visit the vein from before…
